item.title: Show HN: tgv: Genome viewer for you and your agents (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi HN, I'm sharing tgv, a new kind of genome viewer built for humans-agent collaboration in genomics. I work in a cancer diagnostics lab and we check cancer patients' sequencing data in genome viewers every day. Frustrated by the standard tools, last year I built tgv, a Vim-style, keyboard-driven genome viewer. In 2026, while agents are scarily good at bioinformatics, bioinformatics tools haven't kept up. tgv now brings a new kind of research workflow: expose multi-omics data to agents through a fast SQL data layer and they explain the analysis right in the viewer. The TUI is just the start. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50029175 Points: 3 # Comments: 1
